title: Specora Governance Attestation v1.0 (signed-artifact payload)
description: Schema for the canonical payload carried inside a Signed Artifact Envelope (Wire Spec v1.0 §2.8). The 'governance-attestation' spec_id is the reference example used in vectors/signature/signed-artifact-001/. Third parties may sign other payload types — a Signed Artifact Envelope is agnostic to the payload's spec_id — but 'governance-attestation' is the shape referenced from the golden vector suite.
